- **What I checked:** every channel Ilse belongs to (#north-team, #north-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-qfl-sev1) and the public North digests and cheat sheet. They mention two Tamsin problems: a reefer temp-check timeout at Tacoma and a stalled CSV export. Neither has a ticket number, and nothing mentions a gate kiosk outage.
- **What I told them:** that I couldn't find it, and that Dana Okafor is the best person to ask, since Tamsin is Dana's account.
- **Why I didn't use my saved note:** I have a memory note saying the outage is ticket #7852. It was corrected twice before that (#5717, then #7919), and it doesn't say where the number came from. It may have come from a channel or direct message Ilse isn't in, so I couldn't check it or pass it on. If you know the source is something Ilse can see, I can give them the number.
